dataConditions.templateType: letter | report | poem | timeline; a persisted narrative report uses report
dataConditions.generatedContent: non-empty validated structured output with [SourceAnchor] and typed cited/noSource/partialNoSource provenance

expectedSemantics.citationAnchors: zero or more valid Source memory anchors per paragraph plus explicit noSource/partialNoSource status; no Verified fact claim
expectedSemantics.copyButton: Revalidate current policy, then copy title and body without appended source metadata or show a recoverable authorization error
expectedSemantics.exportButton: Revalidate current policy, then export title/body-only PDF/Markdown without appended source identifiers; PDF supports multiple pages without truncation
expectedSemantics.saveToNotesButton: Revalidate current policy, prepare a title/body-only local export, and present the user-mediated system share controller without claiming the content was saved to Notes
expectedSemantics.shareButton: Share/export/print a persisted narrative report under current-policy revalidation (US-SYN-004 AC-6/7)
